text_block_list.text: One day just before tryouts...

You're leaving the school?! Whaddya
mean?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hearing Хиши Амадзон's flustered voice
booming down from the
rooftop, I hurry
upstairs to look into the situation.

There, I see Amazon speaking to the
student that she had been
training with
previously.

Do you know what you're saying right
now? You can't be serious...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I am. I can't stick around and pretend any
longer.
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text: How can you say that?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Remember what you told me? When you
first came to see me in the
dorm?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You said you had a longtime rival that you
wanted to beat in the
Twinkle Series!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: What happened to all that fiery passion?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...It's gone.
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The two of us aren't rivals anymore! The
game's already over! She
won!
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Whaddya mean "over"?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Honestly, it'd been nagging at me for a
while. After coming to this
school, she just
kept getting faster. But my improvement
was little to
none.
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
You were even kind enough to help me
out... but it was no use.
Yesterday, I lost to
her by ten lengths.
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Hmm, that is a pretty big margin...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: But you never know! In the next race, you might beat her by ten lengths!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: That's impossible, and you know it!
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for shouting, Hishiama.
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
But some contests are just obvious from
the beginning. So I'm putting
an end to
this pointless rivalry between us.
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Well, I need to go. Thank you for
everything!
text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Wha—hey! Wait!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
"Impossible"? "Over"? How can she say
that?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Whoa! Oh, it's you...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... I really dropped the ball there,
huh? Some dorm mom I am,
not being able
to cheer up one of the youngsters.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I know for a fact that her goal's not
impossible. But lecturing her isn't
gonna
help anything.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Argh, dammit! What am I supposed to do
now?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Considering Amazon isn't the least bit
intimidated by competition
herself, I can
understand how this would be a difficult
problem to
solve.
As she wracks her brain for the answer...

There you are, Hishiama! I've been looking
all over for you!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text: Well, if it ain't Biko. What's up?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We're racing on the same day of tryouts,
right? The groups were just
announced, so
I thought I'd let you know the big news!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Get this—you're in the same group as
Brian!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She's a powerful Umamusume who has
already caught the attention of
every
trainer around.

Her older sister, Biwa Hiyahide, has been
tearing up the track since
her own debut,
but Brian is said to possess even greater
potential.
choice_data_list: (What an opponent to go up against...)

text_block_list.text:
I brace myself, fully expecting Amazon to
be shaken to the core.
However...
Got it. Thanks, Biko.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Talk about perfect timing!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
With a fearless grin, she dashes off at full
speed.
I hurry after her, only to find...
Hnghyaaah! Huff, puff...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Huh? Did you follow me here?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
What's it look like? I'm training! Guess I
oughta start out with fifty or
so hill sprints.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Actually, maybe that's not enough. I mean,
this is Brian we're talkin'
about. I'll have to
train like hell to go one-on-one against
her!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: You're not the least bit scared?

text_block_list.text: Course I'm not! Who do you think I am?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Besides... I'm not good with words like Fuji.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
So the best I can do for somebody in a
funk... is just to show 'em how
it's done.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
But even so, I'm gonna pull out all the
stops.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Nothing out there is impossible right from
the get-go! You never
know the outcome
of a match 'til you give it a try!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Amazon makes a deeply heartfelt
declaration, her eyes burning with
resolve.

I find myself wanting to catch a glimpse of
the future that she is so
intently focused
on...
choice_data_list: Mind if I help you train?

text_block_list.text:
Wait, really? You sure? Haha, but you're
not even my trainer, ya big
weirdo!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I don't mind one bit—in fact, that'd be a
huge help. Go ahead and
whip me into
shape!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Thus, we agree for me to oversee Hishi
Amazon's training sessions
until tryouts.
